mainEntity.name: What can go wrong during tub installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are hidden water damage, poor waterproofing, and incorrect drain or level alignment. If those issues are missed, the new tub can leak, squeak, or settle unevenly. A careful installer will inspect the subfloor, test the plumbing, and seal the tub and surround correctly before finishing the job.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hidden water damage, bad waterproofing, and uneven plumbing are the most common problems. Proper inspection and sealing reduce the chance of leaks or settling later.
